name: Accession and file manifest verifier
purpose: Prevent wrong-disease accessions changed files and undocumented source mixing
input_contract: accession snapshot plus file URI size checksum source paper and expected disease tissue modality
output_contract: validated resource manifest or fail-closed identity error
notes: Must reject GSE17356 for CRC and must not infer GSE17536 as an automatic correction.

name: Cell to sample to donor mapper
purpose: Establish the independent biological unit and treatment provenance
input_contract: cell identifiers sample metadata donor tissue treatment study and library fields
output_contract: one-row-per-cell mapping audit plus one-row-per-donor tissue summary and unmatched report
notes: No biological model runs before this contract passes.

name: Donor-aware macrophage state and QC analysis
purpose: Test whether candidate states survive mitochondrial and study confounding
input_contract: macrophage counts donor sample tissue study treatment pct_mito n_umi and locked QC specification
output_contract: donor-pseudobulk expression state abundance effects QC sensitivity and leave-one-study-out tables
notes: Harmony or UMAP output cannot substitute for donor-level inference.

name: Locked multigene metabolic-program scorer
purpose: Replace ATP5F1E or MT-CO1 single-marker labels with a computable program
input_contract: ordered genes directions scale mapping duplicate and missing policies plus expression matrix
output_contract: cell and donor program scores with locked version and sensitivity without ATP5F1E MT-CO1 or SPP1
notes: A transcriptional program must not be named as metabolic flux without functional evidence.

name: Independent cohort reference mapping
purpose: Apply the locked state without refitting on validation outcomes
input_contract: discovery reference locked program validation counts donor and tissue metadata
output_contract: validation donor scores mapping uncertainty and direction effect table
notes: Independent means no genes thresholds or labels are changed after viewing the cohort.

name: Patient-level spatial mapping and negative controls
purpose: Test primary and CRLM localization without treating bins as cells
input_contract: spatial counts coordinates images donor ROI treatment and locked reference program
output_contract: patient-level regional enrichment proximity estimates permutations and source table
notes: Primary CRC and CRLM are separate evidence roles and are never silently pooled.

name: Noninteractive Figure and source-table builder
purpose: Make every plotted point traceable to patient-level evidence
input_contract: validated analysis tables plot specification labels and output directory
output_contract: versioned figures captions source tables and machine-readable metadata
notes: No manual editing of values or unpublished GUI state.

name: Cell-source-specific SPP1 program constructor
purpose: Separate macrophage tumour and fibroblast source programs before testing outcome
input_contract: annotated scRNA counts donor tissue and prespecified source compartments
output_contract: three locked source programs overlap audit and leave-SPP1-out sensitivity
notes: Program source labels must be based on cell context not bulk expression alone.

name: Spatial source attribution and CD8 proximity
purpose: Compare source programs with spatial exclusion under negative controls
input_contract: spatial object histology donor reference programs CD8 program and treatment
output_contract: patient-level source probabilities proximity estimates permutation and mixture-control results
notes: Failure to distinguish sources stops the route rather than producing a generic SPP1 score.

name: Site by treatment design validator
purpose: Verify that site treatment and response can be separately estimated
input_contract: donor sample site treatment response regimen timepoint and cell mapping
output_contract: design matrix rank confounding report and estimable contrast list
notes: The route stops if the intended interaction is not estimable.

name: Donor-level site by treatment interaction model
purpose: Estimate treatment-contextual macrophage remodeling without cell pseudoreplication
input_contract: locked macrophage program donor-pseudobulk or proportions and validated design matrix
output_contract: interaction effect confidence interval diagnostics and independent direction table
notes: Retrospective treatment association does not establish treatment benefit.

name: Full-factorial animal interaction analysis
purpose: Prevent three-arm superiority from being mislabeled synergy
input_contract: animal-level vehicle A B AplusB group data randomization blinding exclusions and primary endpoint
output_contract: predefined main and interaction effects confidence intervals diagnostics and animal-level source table
notes: Implementation begins only after wet-lab protocol and power review.

name: Bounded SPP1 versus SELENOP direction reproduction
purpose: Reproduce one anchor direction in one traceable cohort under repaired statistics
input_contract: GSE164522 parsed macrophage counts donor tissue QC and locked state definition
output_contract: donor-level SPP1 and SELENOP program effect table QC sensitivity and two reproducible figures
notes: Expected anchor direction is compared after execution but is never encoded as a passing test.
